author: NingMeng123

selection.trigger: After a source target candidate passes legality and required line of sight; not every tick or potion impact
selection.witch_seed_type: signed int32, independently generated and persisted in native entity NBT
selection.username_hash: Java int32 sum(username.charAt(i) * i), UTF-16 indices start at zero
selection.random_seed: signed int32(witch_seed + username_hash), then widened to long
selection.old_special_developer_override: Old atv.inDevMode forces cannot_drink; not mapped to ordinary NeoForge dev runs

lifecycle.source_storage: Shared world records keyed by case-sensitive player username and caster UUID
lifecycle.modern_storage: Versioned SavedData in the overworld; player UUID identity; original username retained for deterministic selection
lifecycle.offline_pending_realization: Realize at the first online reconciliation at or after the deadline
lifecycle.client_authority: Client receives active type and known flag; server owns all checks, effects, timers and random rolls

discovery.reveal: An actual triggering check requests learn_effect_if_so; wearing armor at realization also reveals if armor was dropped
discovery.known_display: Cursed with specific name and descriptive tooltip

effects.rule: Multiply player equipment durability damage by 2 before the existing native durability pipeline
Clamp assigned air supply to 90; underwater decrease checks reveal the effect
Reject enabling sprint; stop existing sprint on realization
Reject drinking, except the bottle of disenchanting
After nearest legal visible candidate selection through tg -> og -> abw, return hostile if nextInt(3) == 0 and the player has this curse; bypass pumpkin and player stare only
effects.scope: Initial candidate acquisition; retain native gaze behavior for already acquired target freeze and pursuit teleport

effects.repair_quality_checks: Use the same reduced crafting ability and doubled applicable XP fees

effects.rule: Scale horizontal travel input for plant material at player feet
Drop existing humanoid armor on realization and prevent subsequent equipment
Reject chest open checks, including chest subclasses

effects.modern_already_sleeping_handling: Wake the sleeping player when curse realizes

modern_adaptations: Identify the cursed player by UUID so account name changes do not remove the curse; use the original name for selection
Use shared overworld gameTime instead of old independent per-dimension clocks
Server-authoritative fear roll is performed once before weapon durability, on-hit enchantments and damage
Map modern edible items and plant/undead classes explicitly; unknown external foods receive no guessed animal or plant flag
Recheck ingestion throughout use and at completion to prevent mid-use bypass
Honor canceled native witch deaths before removing caster-owned curses

corrections.previous_incorrect_interpretation: Early return inside tg.f bypasses the entire acquisition line-of-sight requirement
corrections.corrected_rule: tg.findPlayerToAttack first calls og and abw candidate filtering, which already requires sensing line of sight; tg.f only bypasses later pumpkin and stare checks
corrections.historical_test_documents: Preserved; new batch verification records the corrected behavior

synchronization.authority: Shared overworld SavedData; serializable player Data Attachment is a mirror
synchronization.recipient: The cursed player only; guarded custom playToClient channel
synchronization.client_discovery_request: Only the sender current active curse can be marked known; cannot apply or lift any curse
synchronization.realization_notice: Separate playToClient payload,100 ticks; reconnecting a realized curse does not replay it
